Using the POS app

Already installed from Google Play?

Update through Google Play to keep your app data and pairing. The signed APK is for a fresh install or an update from the same GitHub channel. At this till release, Play listed POS 1.0.0. Open Google Play ↗

How do I pair my phone?

Open phone pairing in Till admin. On the phone, open Settings → Pair with till and scan the code. Connect once while online to fetch the offline kit. Get the merchant till →

How does the first top-up work?

A new till can start with an empty wallet. In POS, choose Review top-up to see the card credit, fixed fee and total before paying one Lightning invoice. Tap the card to load the agreed amount. Any fee left after costs stays with the merchant. The sending wallet may charge a routing fee. Top-up guide ↗

Setting up the till

Which cards and registry do I need?

Use Card 4.x and a Card 4.0 registry that supports your federation’s Bitcoin mint, v1 or v2. Confirm support with your operator before joining or issuing cards. The till defaults to registry.fedimintcard.org. Choose the same registry and federation in Setup and on the till. Keep a compatible till available for older cards.

How do I install or update on StartOS?

Choose x86_64 for Intel or AMD and aarch64 for ARM64. For an update, back up the existing service and sideload the matching package over it. Start the service, open Till admin and check that your wallet and phone pairing open. StartOS merchant guide ↗

Before issuing cards

Which registry should I select?

Ask your issuer which registry supports Card 4.0 and your federation’s mint. Choose the matching Test or Live registry in Setup and confirm the app build supports Card 4.0 before preparing cards.

How do I approve a till?

Open Settings → Tills → Add a till. Scan the registry claim QR from the merchant till and check its name before approving it. Till pairing guide ↗
